# Diamond Braces

> Diamond Braces offers comprehensive orthodontic solutions including traditional braces, Invisalign clear aligners, and retainers at 70+ locations across the Northeast.

Diamond Braces is a leading orthodontic provider in New York, New Jersey, Pennsylvania, and Connecticut, serving 175,000+ patients with flexible financing, insurance coverage for 200+ plans, and a Lifetime Smile Maintenance Guarantee. As a top 1% Invisalign provider, they specialize in making teeth straightening accessible and affordable for kids and adults.

## Key Topics

- Invisalign clear aligners
- Traditional braces (metal, ceramic, clear)
- Teeth straightening
- Retainers (Vivera, Essix, Hawley)
- Orthodontic treatment
- Dental financing
- Insurance coverage
- Braces cost and pricing
- Orthodontist services
- Clear aligner alternatives
- Gum health and periodontal disease
- I-Tero digital scans
- Lifetime Smile Maintenance Guarantee
- Multiple Northeast locations
- Affordable payment plans

## Treatment Options

- [Braces for Kids & Adults](https://www.diamondbraces.com/pages/orthodontists-braces): Metal, clear, and invisible braces for kids and adults with affordable plans from $100/month
- [Invisalign Aligners & Clear Braces](https://www.diamondbraces.com/pages/invisalign-aligners): Invisalign clear aligners from top 1% provider with 175,000+ cases from $120/month
- [Retainers for Kids & Adults](https://www.diamondbraces.com/pages/retainers): Clear, fixed, and removable retainers including Vivera, Essix, and Hawley options
